subproblem.title: Uniform C¹ approximation of continuous compactly supported functions with support control
subproblem.statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, f : ℝ^P → ℝ continuous with tsupport f ⊆ B̄_R(0), and θ > 0. Then there is g : ℝ^P → ℝ of class C¹ with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ B̄_{R+1}(0), and |f(x) − g(x)| ≤ θ for every x.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (R θ : ℝ), Continuous f → tsupport f ⊆ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R → 0 < θ → ∃ g : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ tsupport g ⊆ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) (R + 1) ∧ ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ θ
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source. Extracted from step 5 of the supplied parent proof (Simon Ch. 3, 4.3 (†)): 'Mollifying, there is f_θ ∈ C_c^∞ with tsupport f_θ ⊆ B_{R+1}(0) and ‖f − f_θ‖_∞ ≤ θ.' Notation: ℝ^P := Euclid P with Lebesgue measure.

1. Uniform continuity. tsupport f is a closed subset of the compact ball B̄_R(0), so f has compact support; being continuous, f is uniformly continuous. Choose δ₀ > 0 with |f(a) − f(b)| < θ whenever |a − b| < δ₀, and put δ := min(δ₀, 1) > 0.
2. Mollifier. There is a C¹ function ψ₀ : ℝ^P → ℝ with tsupport ψ₀ ⊆ B_δ(0), compact support, values in [0, 1] and ψ₀(0) = 1 (a smooth bump function; Mathlib `exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset`). Its integral c := ∫ ψ₀ is positive, because ψ₀ is continuous, nonnegative, compactly supported and ψ₀(0) ≠ 0. Put ψ := c^{-1} ψ₀. Then ψ is C¹ with compact support, ψ ≥ 0, ∫ ψ = 1, and ψ(t) ≠ 0 implies |t| < δ.
3. Definition and smoothness. Let g := ψ ⋆ f, g(x) = ∫ ψ(t) f(x − t) dt. Since ψ is C¹ with compact support and f is locally integrable (continuous), g is C¹ (convolution with a compactly supported C¹ kernel; Mathlib `HasCompactSupport.contDiff_convolution_left`).
4. Support. support g ⊆ support ψ + support f (Mathlib `support_convolution_subset`). If a ∈ support ψ and b ∈ support f then |a| < δ ≤ 1 and |b| ≤ R, so |a + b| ≤ R + 1. Hence support g ⊆ B̄_{R+1}(0); this ball is closed, so tsupport g ⊆ B̄_{R+1}(0), and since the ball is compact, g has compact support.
5. Uniform estimate. Fix x. Because ∫ ψ = 1, g(x) − f(x) = ∫ ψ(t) (f(x − t) − f(x)) dt (both t ↦ ψ(t) f(x − t) and t ↦ ψ(t) f(x) are continuous with compact support, hence integrable). If ψ(t) ≠ 0 then |(x − t) − x| = |t| < δ ≤ δ₀, so |f(x − t) − f(x)| < θ. Hence |g(x) − f(x)| ≤ ∫ ψ(t) θ dt = θ, i.e. |f(x) − g(x)| ≤ θ. ∎

theorem Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_tma_smooth_approx : ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (R θ : ℝ), Continuous f → tsupport f ⊆ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R → 0 < θ → ∃ g : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ tsupport g ⊆ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) (R + 1) ∧ ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ θ := by
  intro P f R θ hf hR hθ
  have hfc : HasCompactSupport f :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R).of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport f) hR
  have huc : UniformContinuous f := hfc.uniformContinuous_of_continuous hf
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hδ⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuous_iff.1 huc θ hθ
  set δ := min δ₀ 1 with hδdef
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := lt_min hδ₀ one_pos
  obtain ⟨ψ₀, hψ₀ts, hψ₀c, hψ₀s, hψ₀r, hψ₀0⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (E := Euclid P) (s := ball (0 : Euclid P) δ) (x := 0)
      (n := 1) (ball_mem_nhds 0 hδpos)
  have hψ₀nn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ₀ x := fun x => (hψ₀r ⟨x, rfl⟩).1
  set c := ∫ x, ψ₀ x with hcdef
  have hc : 0 < c :=
    hψ₀s.continuous.integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero hψ₀c hψ₀nn
      (by rw [hψ₀0]; norm_num)
  set ψ : Euclid P → ℝ := fun x => c⁻¹ * ψ₀ x with hψdef
  have hψs : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ := contDiff_const.mul hψ₀s
  have hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ := hψ₀c.mul_left
  have hψnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x := fun x => mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hc.le) (hψ₀nn x)
  have hψint : ∫ x, ψ x = 1 := by
    rw [hψdef, integral_const_mul, ← hcdef, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne']
  have hψsupp : ∀ t, ψ t ≠ 0 → ‖t‖ < δ := by
    intro t ht
    have : t ∈ tsupport ψ₀ := subset_tsupport ψ₀ (fun h0 => ht (by simp [hψdef, h0]))
    simpa using hψ₀ts this
  set g : Euclid P → ℝ := convolution ψ f (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume with hgdef
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g :=
    hψc.contDiff_convolution_left (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) hψs hf.locallyIntegrable
  have hgval : ∀ x, g x = ∫ t, ψ t * f (x - t) := by
    intro x
    rw [hgdef, convolution_def]
    simp
  have hgsupp : support g ⊆ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) (R + 1) := by
    refine (support_convolution_subset _).trans ?_
    rintro _ ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
    have ha' : ‖a‖ < δ := hψsupp a ha
    have hb' : ‖b‖ ≤ R := by simpa using hR (subset_tsupport f hb)
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    calc ‖a + b‖ ≤ ‖a‖ + ‖b‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ R + 1 := by
          have : δ ≤ 1 := min_le_right _ _
          linarith
  have hgts : tsupport g ⊆ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) (R + 1) :=
    closure_minimal hgsupp isClosed_closedBall
  refine ⟨g, hg, (isCompact_closedBall _ _).of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport g) hgts,
    hgts, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hint1 : Integrable (fun t => ψ t * f (x - t)) :=
    (hψs.continuous.mul (hf.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      hψc.mul_right
  have hint2 : Integrable (fun t => ψ t * f x) :=
    (hψs.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hψc).mul_const _
  have hdiff : g x - f x = ∫ t, ψ t * (f (x - t) - f x) := by
    simp_rw [hgval, mul_sub]
    rw [integral_sub hint1 hint2, integral_mul_const, hψint, one_mul]
  rw [abs_sub_comm, hdiff]
  calc |∫ t, ψ t * (f (x - t) - f x)| ≤ ∫ t, ψ t * θ := by
        rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
        refine norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
          ((hψs.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hψc).mul_const _)
          (Eventually.of_forall fun t => ?_)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hψnn t)]
        by_cases ht : ψ t = 0
        · simp [ht]
        · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (hψnn t)
          have h1 : dist (x - t) x < δ₀ := by
            rw [dist_eq_norm, sub_sub_cancel_left, norm_neg]
            exact (hψsupp t ht).trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
          exact (by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using (hδ h1).le)
    _ = θ := by rw [integral_mul_const, hψint, one_mul]
proof_key_steps: f has compact support, hence is uniformly continuous: choose δ ≤ 1 for the tolerance θ.
Normalized C¹ bump ψ ≥ 0 with ∫ψ = 1 and support in B_δ(0).
g := ψ ⋆ f is C¹ with support in B_δ(0) + B̄_R(0) ⊆ B̄_{R+1}(0).
|g(x) − f(x)| ≤ ∫ ψ(t)|f(x − t) − f(x)| dt ≤ θ.

audit.reason: Normalized nonnegative bump convolution gives C¹ regularity and the required support bound. Uniform continuity gives the stated error everywhere. The argument covers arbitrary real R, including the empty-support cases.
